scope: Completed TRAIN-internal frozen readout, frozen local oracle and GDF centerline-scale diagnostic only; remaining segmentation experiments are not included.
dataset: AVT CTA vessel-tree public anonymized case IDs; three source cohorts Dongyang, KiTS and Rider

units.support: counts; overlapping windows and sampled patches are not independent patients

null_policy: Empty CSV cells mean unavailable/null, never zero. GDF unsupported bins retain zero support and null statistics. Truly empty oracle patch Dice is null and excluded from nonempty Dice means.
data_exclusions: No images, label masks, centerline coordinates, feature vectors, model weights, draft manuscripts or execution infrastructure records are included.
reproduction_scope: Standard-library recomputation of released derived statistics; not independent recreation of model predictions, per-window errors, target fields or full model experiments.
readout_definition: 16mm half-open windows [4u-6,4u+10), 1mm geometry; local fine proportion uses centerline-node radii<=2mm divided by supported nonempty nodes. Radius boundaries2/4/8mm are operational geometry proxies, not clinical labels. Unknown geometry excluded from proxy supervision.
readout_sampling: TRAIN24 fit and TRAIN12 attribute-label check; all36 patients previously seen by old backbone. Eight fixed patches/case (4 GT-centerline+jitter,4 CT-uniform), at most64 supported nonempty+64 trueempty sampled windows/patch. Inverse inclusion N_stratum/m restores uniform-window measure; patch/case equal. Reported nonempty MSE conditions this measure on supported nonempty windows. This is a fixed sampled-window estimate, not exact full-field scoring.
readout_precision: Classifier frozen eval; AMP feature extraction then explicit phase-aligned FP32 vectors; CPU64 convex full-batch L-BFGS fit; deployed head cast to FP32 and all released metrics re-evaluated using FP32 head/vectors. Raw probability includes empty/presence mass; conditional fine=raw_fine/sum(nonempty classes).
readout_training_objective: Uniform valid-window softCE +(.0001/2)*||W||^2, bias unpenalized; no extra foreground balance; no parameter sweep or endpoint selection.

readout_fit_prior.note: fit24 case-equal window measure conditioned on supported nonempty; GT empty mass=0

oracle_definition: Frozen common constant initialization, alpha1. Three routes: constant s=.2; correct local GT nonempty composition; fixed half-ring relocation of complete composition rows within the same eligible patch positions. Eligible=GT-known nonempty and complete CT window; every other position stays neutral .2. GT gating is confined to this oracle diagnostic, never normal deployment. Operator q0=.2 differs from GT nonempty target empty mass0.
oracle_scoring: Native-precision sigmoid(logits)>=.5; stored Dice uses float32(2TP+1e-6)/(predicted_foreground+GT_foreground+1e-6), full128cubed. Four primary patches averaged within case, then equal mean12 cases. Trueempty and31 nonempty CT-uniform patches reported separately.
oracle_numeric_recheck: Python standard-library float64 count formula is checked within2e-7 absolute Dice ratio, not claimed bit-exact with native sigmoid/FP32 arithmetic. Stored ratios are retained for summary recomputation. Summary comparison tolerance2e-12*max(1,abs(values)).
oracle_stopping_decision: Gate failed. Stop the current raw-A long-run proposal and do not start the predicted conditional-normalization follow-up. Retain all cases and the fixed threshold/window/permutation/seed/gain. This cold initialization does not refute learnable GTA co-adaptation.
GDF_precision: Stored float16 target values read at selected centerline nodes and summarized in float64; not pre-quantization field values.
GDF_bins: radius<=2mm;2<radius<=4mm;4<radius<=8mm;radius>8mm. Upper boundary included. No clinical-small-vessel claim.
GDF_weighting: case_equal: each supported case total weight1 within the selected bin. node_weighted: each selected node weight1; not physical vessel length. Unsupported case/bin omitted only from that conditional mean and explicitly counted.
GDF_quantiles: Left inverse weighted empirical CDF; min atq0,max atq1. Global quantiles/Pearson are retained original summaries; they cannot be reconstructed from only case means/quantiles and are not falsely averaged.
GDF_integrity: All36 geometry file hashes verified in original audit. Target headers/file sizes/selected values checked; target files were not fully rehashed by this centerline audit. Mask access was header and selected node values. Physical I/O was not measured.
GDF_limits: E[target^2] at centerline nodes is not loss, whole-volume energy or segmentation benefit. Radius association may reflect node density, overlap and branching; not a causal test. No formal GDF segmentation validation result is included.
global_limits: These are TRAIN diagnostics, not independent-patient segmentation, zero-shot, cross-domain generalization, repeated-seed variance or a completed whole-stage result. Case SD and worst2 are descriptive across12 cases, not uncertainty guarantees.
